startup_rule: Read PROJECT-BOOTSTRAP.md, PROJECT-OPERATING-MODE-v2.md, PROJECT-MEMORY.json and GIT-SYNC-POLICY.json first.
Prefer the newest valid portable content/workstream state from current chat, Project Sources or Library; verification and Git persistence remain separate.
Consult PROJECT-STATE.json and the relevant GitHub CHECKPOINT.json only as much as needed to resolve ambiguity or sync status.
Resolve the active START-PROMPT from active_framework.entrypoint; do not hard-code an older prompt version.
Resolve registered raw sources from Project Sources first, then Library; do not ask the user to re-upload until both have been checked.
Before proposing automation/process/Git/authority/packaging/source-governance/UI changes, check PROJECT-MEMORY.json and warn if the proposal conflicts with an ACTIVE prior decision.
When runtime/import/presentation compatibility matters, resolve Flashcards CURRENT and LAST_FULLY_VERIFIED separately and target CURRENT.
Git sync may lag and coalesce intermediate batches/versions; never block production or downgrade authority because persistence.git is pending.
